headline: BIIB Q2 Deep Dive: Portfolio Expansion and Pipeline Readouts Drive Upbeat Outlook
summary: Biotech company Biogen (NASDAQ:BIIB) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.4% year on year to $2.74 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.60 per share was 75.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
